privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: {company} complies with Québec's Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector, as amended by Law 25. This policy explains what information we collect on this site, why, and what your rights are.

sections.title: Person in charge of the protection of personal information
body: The person in charge of the protection of personal information at {company} is {officerName}.
For any question or request about your information, write to {officerEmail}.

sections.title: Information we collect
body: When you fill in the quote request, we collect your name, phone number, email address and the details of your shipment: type of shipment, vehicle, container size, destination, preferred date and message.

body.text: Shipment tracking asks for no personal information: it only shows the status of a container or file from its number.

body: To limit abuse, we briefly keep an encrypted fingerprint of the IP address of devices that submit a form. This fingerprint cannot be used to recover the original address.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: Your information is used only to prepare your quote, to reply to you and, if you ship with us, to organise the shipment.
We do not sell your information and we do not use it for advertising.

sections.title: Your consent
body: We collect your information only after you tick the consent box on the form. Without it, the request is not sent.
You can withdraw your consent at any time by writing to the person in charge. We will then delete your request, unless the law requires us to keep it.

sections.title: Service providers and where data is kept
body: We use service providers to run this site: Netlify (website hosting), Supabase (database) and Resend (email delivery). They process your information on our behalf and may not use it for any other purpose.
These providers may store data outside Québec. We considered the protection they offer before choosing them.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Quote requests are kept for {retentionMonths} months after our last exchange, then deleted. Documents related to a completed shipment are kept for as long as the law requires.

sections.title: Security
body: Exchanges with this site are encrypted. Access to requests is restricted to authorised {company} staff and the database is not open to the public.

sections.title: Cookies
body: This site uses no advertising cookies and no tool that tracks your browsing.

body.text: The only cookie in use keeps staff signed in to the administration area.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask to see the information we hold about you, to have it corrected or to have it deleted. Write to the person in charge: we reply within 30 days.
If you are not satisfied with our reply, you can file a complaint with the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec.

sections.title: Changes
body: We update this policy when our practices change. The date of the last update appears at the top of the page.

sections.title: Publisher
body: This site is published by {legalName}, {address}.
Phone: {phone}. Email: {email}.

sections.title: Hosting
body: The site is hosted by Netlify, Inc., 101 2nd Street, San Francisco, California, United States.

sections.title: Published information
body: Transit times and service descriptions are indicative. Only the quote we give you sets the price and conditions of your shipment.

body.text: Shipment tracking reflects the latest steps recorded by our team. The expected arrival date may change depending on the shipping line.

sections.title: Intellectual property
body: The texts, logo and graphic elements of this site belong to {legalName}. They may not be reproduced without permission.

sections.title: Personal information
body: How we handle your personal information is described in our privacy policy.
